description: Turns sign-in on or off for one site's previews or its live site, as the switches in the project's "Who can see it" settings do. With sign-in on, only people in the workspace can open it, after they sign in; with it off, anyone with the address can. Only owners and admins. Previews, and turning sign-in on for the live site, change at once. Turning sign-in off for the live site only asks: Nothing happens until you approve it in CodeGene: the answer gives a link to the request, which waits there for 15 minutes. Send the person that link; you cannot approve it. Then call get_approval with the requestId to learn how it ended. Without address, a live change applies to every part of the live site that can be switched.

address.description: For live only: the one address to change, as get_site_protection lists it, such as www.acme.com.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

sign_in.description: true: only people in the workspace, after they sign in. false: anyone with the address.

target.description: previews: every preview of the site. live: the live site visitors see.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: set_site_protection
title: Turn sign-in on or off for a site
